errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Z.AI search endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Z.AI search requires an API key. Set ZAI_API_KEY or configure zaiApiKey, then select zai in Settings (General page).
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Z.AI API key rejected. Check ZAI_API_KEY or zaiApiKey in settings.
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Z.AI search rate-limited or quota exceeded. Wait and retry or check your Z.AI plan.
errors.serverError: web_search: Z.AI search server error ({status}). Try again later or select another engine.
errors.parseError: web_search: Z.AI search returned an unparseable response (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
